control.name: Quarterly Privileged Access Review
control.description: Requires periodic manager review and certification of employees holding privileged system access.
control.requirement_text: For each fiscal quarter, the designated control owner must review the full list of privileged access holders and certify, in writing, that access remains appropriate. The review must be completed and evidenced within 360 hours (15 calendar days) of the quarter's end date.

query.scenario_description: Determine whether the Q1 2025 privileged access review for this control was completed in accordance with the control's timeliness requirement.

control.name: Third-Party Vendor Risk Assessment
control.description: Requires periodic risk assessment of third-party vendors with access to production data.
control.requirement_text: Each third-party vendor with access to production data must undergo a documented risk assessment at least once per fiscal quarter. If a vendor is rated High Risk (or upgraded to a higher risk tier), any required remediation action must be completed, or the vendor's continued access constitutes an exception.

query.scenario_description: Determine whether vendor Acme Logistics satisfied the third-party vendor risk assessment control for Q1 2026.

control.name: Encryption Key Rotation
control.description: Requires periodic rotation of encryption keys for production systems.
control.requirement_text: Encryption keys for production systems must be rotated according to the key-rotation policy version in effect on the date each rotation cycle began.

control.name: Production Change Management Approval
control.description: Requires documented pre-deployment approval for production changes.
control.requirement_text: Every production change must have documented pre-deployment approval, recorded in the change management system by an approver with the authority defined in the Change Management Policy, before the change is deployed.

query.scenario_description: Determine whether change ticket CHG-88213 satisfied the change management pre-deployment approval control for Q2 2026.

control.name: Critical Vulnerability Remediation SLA
control.description: Requires timely remediation of critical-severity vulnerabilities.
control.requirement_text: Critical-severity vulnerabilities must be remediated within 15 days of discovery. Lower-severity vulnerabilities are governed by separate, longer SLAs not evaluated by this control. Remediation SLA compliance requires both a discovery date and a remediation completion date.

query.scenario_description: Determine whether CVE-2026-0091 was remediated within the required 15-day SLA for critical vulnerabilities.

control.name: Quarterly Database Privileged Role Certification (Alternate-Source Provision)
control.description: Requires certification that privileged database roles assigned to individual accounts remain appropriate, with an explicit allowance for a sufficient alternate source when the primary governance tool is unavailable.
control.requirement_text: Each quarter, the database administration team must certify that privileged database roles (e.g., DBA, sysadmin) assigned to individual accounts remain appropriate, based on an extract from the database access governance tool. If the database access governance tool is unavailable for the period, an equivalent extract of privileged database role assignments, covering the same scope of accounts and roles, may substitute for it, provided the substitute extract is (a) sourced independently of the unavailable tool and (b) signed off by a reviewer attesting to its accuracy and completeness. No substitute source narrows, waives, or otherwise reduces the certification requirement itself.

query.scenario_description: Determine whether privileged database role assignments were certified as required for Q1 2026, given that the primary extraction tool returned an error.
